capabilities: , Display selected text in floating windows
Maintain original document rendering and theme style
Automatically size windows based on content
Position windows intelligently near the selection
Allow interaction with the floating window
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to display selected text passages in independent floating windows while maintaining the exact same rendering and theme style as the original document.
problem: When reading long documents, it is difficult to keep important paragraphs visible and accessible for cross-referencing without losing context in the main document flow.
summary: Floating Window displays selected text passages in independent floating windows while maintaining the exact rendering and theme style of the original document.
